newsitem.title: USA: Cole National buys Pearle in $165 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Cole National buys Pearle in $165 mln deal.

text.p: Cole National Corp said Wednesday it has agreed to buy the stock and certain assets of Pearle Inc from Pillsbury Co, a subsidiary of Grand Metropolitan PLC.
Cole said it will pay about $165 million for Pearle and minority investment in Pearle's European operations.
The company said it expects the transaction to be accretive to earnings in its next fiscal year and bring annual company revenues to more than $900 million.
The acquisition is expected to be completed during Cole National's fourth quarter.

In a related transaction, Cole said it has agreed to sell Pearle's European business to a company organized by HAL Investments B.V., a Rotterdam-based investment group, with certain members of the Pearle B.V. management team. Cole said it will retain a minority interest in the European operations.
Pearle has 692 stores in North America and 183 in The Netherlands and Belgium operated by Pearle B.V.
Cole National operates more than 1,000 optical stores under the names "Sears Optical," "Montgomery Ward Vision Center," "BJ's Optical" and "Target Optical."
The company said it plans to keep the Pearle Vision name and the Pearle retail system separate.
